races.name: Start Your Racing TV Free Trial Now Maiden Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict:
POWER OF KNOWLEDGE is bred to be an above-average prospect and, with his recent bumper debut under his belt, looks to have been found a good opportunity to make a winning start over hurdles. Midfield Magic shaped well on debut for Tom Dreaper and should have more to offer now with Gavin Cromwell, while Tomthescaffolder is also capable of being involved if bouncing back from an odds-on defeat last time.

  1. POWER OF KNOWLEDGE (IRE)
  2. MIDFIELD MAGIC (IRE)
  3. TOMTHESCAFFOLDER

races.name: Start Your Racing TV Free Trial Now Maiden Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict:
GOEASYONME was unfancied on debut but shaped with enough promise to suggest he is capable of landing an ordinary maiden, and this looks just such an opportunity. Combs is respected on the pick of his efforts last season and can pose the main threat, while Texas Red is fancied to be in the mix for minor honours once again.

  1. GOEASYONME (FR)
  2. COMBS (IRE)
  3. TEXAS RED (FR)

races.name: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
ROKANAKO proved himself fairly useful in bumpers and made a positive start for this yard at Killarney last month. He is taken to make a successful hurdling debut. Splendid Fellow and It's All Clear rate the principal dangers.

  1. ROKANAKO (IRE)
  2. SPLENDID FELLOW (IRE)
  3. IT'S ALL CLEAR (IRE)

races.name: Midland Breeders Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
STEPS IN THE SAND seems best around this trip and can go one place better than at Bellewstown last week. Willie Mullins' handicap newcomer Ivana d'Alco has to be respected in opposition, with the consistent Chemdawg also meriting consideration.

  1. STEPS IN THE SAND (IRE)
  2. IVANA D'ALCO (FR)
  3. CHEMDAWG (IRE)

races.name: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
TUTU TWIST has shown enough to suggest she can win a race of this nature. Willie Mullins' newcomer Blue Trix is feared, especially if the market vibes are strong. Likely improver Not In A Hurry completes the shortlist.

  1. TUTU TWIST (IRE)
  2. BLUE TRIX (IRE)
  3. NOT IN A HURRY (IRE)

races.name: Clarke's Bar Mullingar Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Runner-up on handicap debut, EYE CONTACT faced a tough ask at Killarney on his latest outing and he is taken to get back on track as he drops in grade. Dairy Force had been in good form prior to falling last time and rates next best, with Rockstown Girl also in the mix.

  1. EYE CONTACT
  2. DAIRY FORCE (IRE)
  3. ROCKSTOWN GIRL (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Flat Race
races.verdict:
A few with chances but it could pay to side with BALLITO BEAUTY who made a promising start when an unlucky-in-running second in a Sligo bumper and can build on it to go one better here. Tamara Jane sets a decent standard and seems sure to go close, while both Peat Sounds and Back In Favour can also go well in a competitive bumper.

  1. BALLITO BEAUTY (IRE)
  2. TAMARA JANE (IRE)
  3. PEAT SOUNDS (IRE)

races.name: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
IFUKNOWUKNOW showed some promise in a pair of bumpers last season, including in a race at Leopardstown won by subsequent Champion Bumper winner The Mourne Rambler, so it's reasonable to believe he could improve on his return for a new yard, especially now stepping up to a more suitable trip. Myluckymaker was value for finishing further clear of the third on her recent stable bow and is feared, along with Killeedy, who had a wider trip than ideal on her debut at Killarney.

  1. IFUKNOWUKNOW (IRE)
  2. MYLUCKYMAKER (IRE)
  3. KILLEEDY (IRE)

races.name: Download The At The Races App Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PRINCESS HONEY BEE couldn't justify cramped odds when fourth at Windsor 24 days ago but is afforded another chance to confirm the promise of her penultimate Ripon second behind a useful prospect. Mystic Music finished a couple of places in front of the selection latest and remains open to improvement, not least back over longer trips. Hamdania, a winner at Wolverhampton last winter, also commands respect despite conceding weight all round.

  1. PRINCESS HONEY BEE
  2. MYSTIC MUSIC
  3. HAMDANIA (IRE)

races.name: Castle Air Handicap
races.verdict:
TWILIGHT MOON has a good record here, including when winning over C&D off this mark on her comeback in the spring, so she makes most appeal returned to the all-weather. Sibling Rivelry continues to hold her form well and she rates the main threat.

  1. TWILIGHT MOON
  2. SIBLING RIVELRY
  3. MISTER DAYDREAM (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks wide open with NOBLE VOW taken to get back on track having had excuses on his last 2 starts. Wyle Cop and Truly Glamorous can make it a 1-2-3 for the 3-y-os.

  1. NOBLE VOW (IRE)
  2. WYLE COP (USA)
  3. TRULY GLAMOROUS

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 / EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KAMAAL sets a clear standard on his Royal Ascot form but it would come as no surprise if the highly-regarded Mouj Albuhoor made a good race of it.

  1. KAMAAL (IRE)
  2. MOUJ ALBUHOOR (IRE)
  3. SATURN STAR (IRE)

races.name: KSS De Triomphe Handicap
races.verdict:
FABLED SPIRIT only just failed to make a winning all-weather debut over C&D last month and is fancied to go one better up only 1 lb. Sir Griflet wasn't far behind the selection that day when a back-to-form fourth so he's second choice.

  1. FABLED SPIRIT (IRE)
  2. SIR GRIFLET (IRE)
  3. ADA ROSE

races.name: CSIS - Neigh Nonsense Insurance Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
ANGELS' SHARE is a much more solid proposition on the all-weather, especially at this track (2 from 2), and she looks ready to take advantage of her reduced mark. Ironist could bounce back with her yard in better form now, while Searchingtheblues responded well to cheekpieces when second at Ffos Las.

  1. ANGELS' SHARE
  2. IRONIST (IRE)
  3. SEARCHINGTHEBLUES

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
GO LOCKERS GO got back on track despite not being seen to best effect here on his most recent outing and, having slipped to a mark only 2 lb higher than for the second of his 2 wins in the spring, he earns the vote. Acclaimed Freedom and Far Too Fizzy head the dangers.

  1. GO LOCKERS GO
  2. ACCLAIMED FREEDOM
  3. FAR TOO FIZZY

races.name: Air Ambulance Charity Kent Surrey Sussex Handicap
races.verdict:
BOSTON RUN is still searching for a first win but turned in his best of the season when a close second over C&D 17 days ago and a reproduction of that form may well suffice. Sole 3-y-o Lady of Clover is unexposed over middle distances and could well raise her game further.

  1. BOSTON RUN (IRE)
  2. LADY OF CLOVER (IRE)
  3. HAVEAGOBEAU

races.name: Border Minstrel Pub Handicap
races.verdict:
SATYRESS has won both starts since upped to this trip, doing well in the circumstances when scoring at Hamilton last time, and she can continue her progress to land the hat-trick. Lawmans Blis arrives on the back of a successful stable debut and is feared most under a penalty, ahead of Gemini Man.

  1. SATYRESS
  2. LAWMANS BLIS (IRE)
  3. GEMINI MAN (IRE)

races.name: Admiral Winning Line Handicap
races.verdict:
MWAFAQ remains on an upward curve and shaped like the best horse at the weights when an unlucky fifth at Lingfield 2 weeks ago, so he is taken to resume winning ways at the chief expense of Iain Jardine's Southwell winner Junkyard Dog and top-weight Shimmering Sands.

  1. MWAFAQ (IRE)
  2. JUNKYARD DOG (IRE)
  3. SHIMMERING SANDS

races.name: Admiral Jackpot Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
INTERSTATE took another step forward on his handicap debut when going close at Sandown last time and he is taken to prove too strong for his only realistic rival Quiet Summer, who was much improved from debut when runner-up at Kempton recently.

  1. INTERSTATE
  2. QUIET SUMMER (GER)
  3. TREBLE BASS

races.name: Christmas Parties At Newcastle Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
HOME SECRETARY seemed to benefit from both the application of a visor and a step up to a staying trip when winning at Lingfield in July and he should prove difficult to beat. Tarbat Ness makes most appeal of the remainder.

  1. HOME SECRETARY
  2. TARBAT NESS
  3. IT'S ALL ABOUT YOU (IRE)

races.name: Admiral Race To Riches Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MUSSAB drops markedly in class and a reproduction of his third in the Norfolk Stakes at Royal Ascot should be enough to see him break his duck. Well-bred debutant Caelum is a half-brother to very smart 6f winner and can pose a threat, whilst Perfect Strike may benefit from the drop to 5f and represents a top yard.

  1. MUSSAB
  2. CAELUM (IRE)
  3. PERFECT STRIKE (FR)

races.name: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
races.verdict:
WILLOWINGHURN returned to near her best when third at Ffos Las 13 days ago and she's weighted to win this if proving as effective back on all-weather. Victory Sound wasted no time getting back to form when second at Lingfield 16 days ago and could prove a threat, while Turbo Command holds place claims, too.

  1. WILLOWINGHURN
  2. VICTORY SOUND (IRE)
  3. TURBO COMMAND (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ASADJUMEIRAH gained his sixth C&D victory in July and, having run creditably here last time, he could be up to adding to his tally. Liquid Cooled looks an interesting contender, though, back at the scene of his handicap debut success, with last-time-out winner Dream Forever also considered.

  1. ASADJUMEIRAH
  2. LIQUID COOLED (IRE)
  3. DREAM FOREVER (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
EM JAY KAY showed clear signs of a return to form when fourth at Windsor 10 days ago, doing good late work without being knocked about, and this C&D winner can capitalise on an attractive mark back up to 6f. Tomorrow Day has recorded all of his 5 career wins at this track and could prove the biggest danger if fit returning from a 176-day absence.

  1. EM JAY KAY
  2. TOMORROW DAY
  3. LITTLE BECK ANNIE

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap
races.verdict:
HARB confirmed his return to form when winning at Beverley just 4 days ago and can follow up under a penalty if this doesn't come too soon. DC Cogent isn't easy to catch right but could be a threat from career-low mark, while Too Much is respected dropping back into easier company having won over C&D in July.

  1. HARB
  2. DC COGENT
  3. TOO MUCH

races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
VIRTUE PATIENCE's sole success came on the back of a break and Amanda Perrett's 4-y-o gets the vote to repeat that feat returning from 3 months off here. Prince Rasam looked well suited by 1m when runner-up at Kempton back in May, so he heads up the opposition also returning from an absence, with Decalogue rounding off the shortlist after an improved effort at Newmarket last time.

  1. VIRTUE PATIENCE
  2. PRINCE RASAM
  3. DECALOGUE (USA)

races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
NIGHT STAR has shown plenty in 3 starts and is given a final chance to open his account. My Boy should step up from his initial experience and can take advantage should the selection fail to fire, with Lauriger appealing as the most interesting of the newcomers.

  1. NIGHT STAR (IRE)
  2. MY BOY (IRE)
  3. LAURIGER (FR)

races.name: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
HEREWARD showed plenty on debut in quite a competitive race and a repeat of that effort will make him hard to beat. Ahmadi looks sure to be suited by this longer trip and should be thereabouts, while Mr Badger ran the quickest final 1f on debut and can step up on his initial experience.

  1. HEREWARD (FR)
  2. AHMADI (IRE)
  3. MR BADGER

races.name: British EBF Quidhampton Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A valuable fillies' maiden which can go the way of THI QAR, who shaped with plenty of encouragement when runner-up at Newmarket on debut last month and John & Thady Gosden's filly is sure to have derived plenty from that initial effort. Miss Miniver also found just one too strong first time up and she can provide most resistance, with Concurrent and Costa Verde a couple of newcomers to note, as well.

  1. THI QAR (IRE)
  2. MISS MINIVER (IRE)
  3. CONCURRENT

races.name: IRE-Incentive, It Pays To Buy Irish Dick Poole Fillies' Stakes (Fillies' Group 3)
races.verdict:
An open-looking renewal of the Dick Poole in which preference is for DARK ISSUE, who has some strong form to her name and Richard Hannon's filly is fancied to put her lesser effort at Ascot just under 6 weeks ago behind her. Nuit d'Eclair has acquitted herself very well at pattern level the last twice, so she could be the one to give the selection most to think about, with Miss Kodi and Harlequin Sky another couple worth considering, too.

  1. DARK ISSUE (IRE)
  2. NUIT D'ECLAIR (IRE)
  3. MISS KODI (IRE)

races.name: European Bloodstock News EBF 'Lochsong' Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A case can be made for several but preference is for the lightly raced MISS NIGHTCAP to resume winning ways back in handicap company. Course specialist Zen Diva rates a major danger despite a significant hike in the weights, with Havana Pusey also in the mix for the places.

  1. MISS NIGHTCAP
  2. ZEN DIVA
  3. HAVANA PUSEY

races.name: Madar Corporation Handicap
races.verdict:
POINT OF CONTACT gets the nod with the headgear applied and has already tasted success on the previous occasion Murphy took the reins. The form of Boyfriend's last run is working out so he rates a big danger from Principality and Colourband, in that order.

  1. POINT OF CONTACT (IRE)
  2. BOYFRIEND
  3. PRINCIPALITY (IRE)

races.name: Lester Aldridge Handicap
races.verdict:
KAMAWAY was below form at Sandown last time but had been progressive prior to that blip, and she is taken to bounce back at a track where she has already won this year. Lucky Camino is another with more to offer and rates the chief threat ahead of Zgharta, who also needs to bounce back from a poor effort but is on a handy mark for a yard in form.

  1. KAMAWAY
  2. LUCKY CAMINO (IRE)
  3. ZGHARTA (IRE)

races.name: 100% RacingTV Profits Back To Racing Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
FLIGHTOFTHEPHOENIX carries a penalty for last week's Ffos Las victory but she won in decisive fashion and may be the answer to a tricky-looking opener. Austrian Theory has dropped to an attractive mark and is feared most, whilst Revelio is less exposed than his rivals and has the assistance of Henry Callan.

  1. FLIGHTOFTHEPHOENIX (IRE)
  2. AUSTRIAN THEORY (IRE)
  3. REVELIO

races.name: EBF Novice Stakes
races.verdict:
BURNING UP scored in very good style when making a winning start over C&D 4 weeks ago and he should prove more than capable of defying a penalty. The biggest threat is likely to come from a newcomer, with Austin and Zarak Crown perhaps most interesting of those.

  1. BURNING UP
  2. AUSTIN
  3. ZARAK CROWN (FR)

races.name: Jackie Harbridge In Loving Memory Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FLYING PIRATE is already proven on soft ground and a recent gelding operation may well help unlock further potential. Fitted with cheekpieces, he looks the one to beat. Potential improvers Reflect On Glory and All I Know rate the principal dangers.

  1. FLYING PIRATE (IRE)
  2. REFLECT ON GLORY (IRE)
  3. ALL I KNOW

races.name: Bailey Partnership Celebrating 50 Years Nursery
races.verdict:
Preference is for GREEN TITAN, who got back on track at Wolverhampton last month and may well be suited by this longer trip now fitted with headgear. Diplomata and Katie's Cavalier head the list of dangers.

  1. GREEN TITAN
  2. DIPLOMATA
  3. KATIE'S CAVALIER (IRE)

races.name: EBF Ashton In Makerfield Novice Stakes
races.verdict:
The market should reveal plenty here but the William Haggas-trained SHARADD is bred to be well above average and holds a Group 1 Dewhurst entry so is taken to make a winning start at the chief expense of Does Mary Know who shaped well when runner-up at Ripon last time and sets a good standard. Al Arraab and Time To Play are other newcomers who could play a part in an intriguing novice.

  1. SHARADD (IRE)
  2. DOES MARY KNOW
  3. AL ARRAAB (IRE)

races.name: Reprocolor Premier EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
None of these can be ruled out but the upwardly-mobile HOSEKI didn't enjoy the rub of the green when a very good fourth at Ascot last time and is fancied to quickly resume winning ways. Gemma Tutty's Star Cast seems sure to go well in her bid for a remarkable seventh success of 2026, while Polygram and Hollywell Stream are other in-form fillies who can also play a prominent role here.

  1. HOSEKI (IRE)
  2. STAR CAST
  3. POLYGRAM

races.name: Visit racingtv.com Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and this looks a good opportunity for NIGHTSINWHITESATIN to gain a deserved first success of 2026 after a series of runner-up efforts. Pol Roger is feared most on the back of a recent Ayr success, while fellow course scorer Pearl Eye can also have a say. Storm Point completes the shortlist on his first go over this trip.

  1. NIGHTSINWHITESATIN
  2. POL ROGER (IRE)
  3. PEARL EYE

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
It could be worth taking a chance on INVINCIBLE CROWN, who is no stranger to success on the all-weather and drops back down in grade here. What A Tahoo has been prolific of late, and she's feared most ahead of the consistent Startling.

  1. INVINCIBLE CROWN (IRE)
  2. WHAT A TAHOO (IRE)
  3. STARTLING

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks an excellent opportunity for BLACK ORCHID to get off the mark. Elyam, Gris De Chine and Atomik can battle it out for the minor honours.

  1. BLACK ORCHID
  2. ELYAM
  3. GRIS DE CHINE

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
GRAND PIER has progressed with each start this season, including when winning last time, and looks sure to go close from the same mark if handling the quick turnaround. Much, Roker Roar and Mr Moonshine head the list of dangers.

  1. GRAND PIER
  2. MUCH
  3. ROKER ROAR (IRE)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
There's every chance that well-related CASTLEMONT can defy a penalty for his debut success. Improving Walking On Stars is entitled to make a race of it at the weights.

  1. CASTLEMONT (IRE)
  2. WALKING ON STARS (IRE)
  3. MAESTRO DEL MAR (FR)

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
THE THIRD STAR looks interesting returning to the scene of her sole previous success, and she gets the vote in an open-looking fillies handicap. Luminare has the strongest claims of the remainder, though Great Mates and Enola Grey are by no means back numbers.

  1. THE THIRD STAR
  2. LUMINARE (IRE)
  3. GREAT MATES

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
Handicap debutant FRANSCHHOEK ticks plenty of boxes, and he's fancied to follow up his Wolverhampton maiden win. Hot And Cold looks worth another chance in a race where she could get the run of things.

  1. FRANSCHHOEK
  2. HOT AND COLD
  3. KALAMUNDA

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
The vote goes to PISCEAN STAR, who is seemingly a much better horse on the all-weather and could get back on track with Billy Loughnane aboard. A reasonable case can be made for Lieutenant Kije on the best of his all-weather form, while Korbut is respected now up and running.

  1. PISCEAN STAR
  2. LIEUTENANT KIJE
  3. KORBUT

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
A trappy sprint in which it could be worth taking a chance on ROCK OPERA, who hasn't been seen on synthetics since November 2024 but Richard & Peter Fahey's 6-y-o has dropped to a handy mark and attracted good support at Doncaster last month. Diligent Resdev promises to be suited by this return to 6f, so he's put forward as the main threat, with Moving Force and Modern Times also fancied to be in the mix, too.

  1. ROCK OPERA
  2. DILIGENT RESDEV
  3. MOVING FORCE (IRE)

Prix Gerald De Geoffre Group 3 Stakes
Prix Remus De La Tour Claiming Stakes
